role: individual review of the security-deep heuristic bucket

reviews.subject: fix(material/datepicker): deprecate constructor injection in NativeDateAdapter
reviews.evidence: The patch removes the Platform constructor parameter from Material's NativeDateAdapter. This package re-exports that symbol from @angular/material/core and does not implement it.

reviews.subject: fix(material/progress-bar): avoid CSP issues for apps not using buffer mode
reviews.evidence: The patch stops rendering MDC buffer dots unless mode is buffer. The owned legacy progress bar template uses an inline SVG pattern and does not render mdc-linear-progress__buffer-dots.

reviews.subject: fix(material/progress-bar): avoid CSP issues due to buffer dots
reviews.evidence: The patch replaces an MDC data-URI mask with a radial gradient. The owned progress-bar stylesheet has no data URI. The vendored linear-progress theme still has a data-URI background inside an IE11 media query only.

reviews.subject: perf(material/tooltip): Defer injection of injectables not needed until tooltip is shown.
reviews.evidence: The patch defers Overlay, ScrollDispatcher, ViewContainerRef, and DOCUMENT injection. It does not change a security sink. No tooltip security edit follows from it.

reviews.subject: refactor: move trusted types logic into CDK
reviews.evidence: The patch moves trustedHTMLFromString into @angular/cdk/private and updates Material's icon registry. This package has neither that helper nor a cdk/private import.

reviews.subject: fix(cdk/layout): avoid CSS injection attacks in media matcher
reviews.evidence: The patch strips curly braces before MediaMatcher inserts a stylesheet rule. The only owned call passes the constant prefers-reduced-motion query, which contains no braces. The installed CDK file was not opened, so this review does not claim the peer contains the fix.

limitations: The 1697-row seed still marks every SHA open, including these six.
